purpose: Synthetic recovery of per-train factor w_k from hourly cell marginals; real peak cases never read
model: x[k,a,b] = w_k * beta[cell(a)] * pi[a->b]; cell = station x stop-hour (gt_train_od convention)
beta_true: B_obs[cell] / sum of w over the cell's non-terminal events

scenarios.d_alternate: per direction, trains sorted by origin departure alternate 0.7/1.3 (even index 0.7, odd 1.3)

noise: none or 2% multiplicative Gaussian per cell (seed 7), clipped at 0.5

estimators.E1: pi = true, estimate w and beta (L-BFGS on log params, maxiter 6000)
estimators.E2: pi free (per-event softmax logits) with lam*KL(pi||uniform) weighted by boarding mass; joint L-BFGS maxiter 3000; main off=10 lam=0.01
estimators.E3: exploratory: shared kernel pi proportional to alpha[cell(b)]*exp(-delta*d), alpha/delta free, flat init, no KL; maxiter 3000

metrics.within_hour_corr: subtract mean w within each origin-departure-hour group (both directions pooled) from w_hat and w_true, correlate
metrics.peak_time_error: time of max 3-train moving average (same direction) of w_hat in [06:00,10:30] vs 08:15 and [16:00,20:30] vs 18:15

decision_rules.success: within-hour corr >= 0.9 in E2 at 2% noise for scenarios a, b, d (all three) => SUCCESS
decision_rules.failure: all three < 0.5 => FAILURE; anything else PARTIAL (report which scenarios)
decision_rules.null: scenario c at 2% noise: std(w_hat)/mean(w_hat) <= 0.05 else the method invents patterns (FAIL regardless)
decision_rules.verdict_basis: E2 (declared realistic estimator); E1 and E3 are reported but do not decide

resources: <=3 workers, OMP/MKL threads 1, BELOW_NORMAL priority, per-stage limit 15 min
